description: This file defines an abstract class for Android test suites and a factory class for creating such test suites, including methods for managing test properties and execution.

classes.name: AbstractTestSuite
classes.description: Represents a generic test suite with properties like name, build path, dependencies, permissions, and methods to get/set these properties, as well as an abstract run method.

classes.name: AbstractTestFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing test suites, providing methods to get build paths, test root paths, and create tests (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test suite.

methods.name: SetName
methods.description: Sets the name of the test suite.

methods.name: GetBuildPath
methods.description: Returns the build path of the test suite.

methods.name: SetBuildPath
methods.description: Sets the build path of the test suite.

methods.name: GetBuildDependencies
methods.description: Returns a list of build dependencies.

methods.name: SetBuildDependencies
methods.description: Sets the list of build dependencies.

methods.name: IsContinuous
methods.description: Checks if the test is part of continuous testing.

methods.name: SetContinuous
methods.description: Sets whether the test is part of continuous testing.

methods.name: IsGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the test should be granted runtime permissions.

methods.name: SetIsGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Sets whether the test should be granted runtime permissions.

methods.name: GetSuite
methods.description: Returns the name of the test suite.

methods.name: SetSuite
methods.description: Sets the name of the test suite.

methods.name: GetDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the test suite.

methods.name: SetDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the test suite.

methods.name: GetExtraBuildArgs
methods.description: Returns extra build arguments.

methods.name: SetExtraBuildArgs
methods.description: Sets extra build arguments.

methods.name: IsFullMake
methods.description: Checks if the test requires a full make.

methods.name: SetIsFullMake
methods.description: Sets whether the test requires a full make.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Abstract method to run the test, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetBuildPath
methods.description: Returns the build path from the factory.

methods.name: GetTestsRootPath
methods.description: Returns the root path for tests.

methods.name: CreateTests
methods.description: Abstract method to create tests, to be implemented by subclasses.
